name: @hl-bos/jersey-sort-app
description: JerseySort AI — turn hundreds of game photos into organized player galleries in minutes. Sign in, create an event, upload a batch of sports photos, and JerseySort reads the jersey numbers in each one, files every photo under each athlete in it, and sends the uncertain ones to a fast review queue. Runs on this computer; photos are stored locally and only ever served to a signed-in member of the organization that uploaded them.
